verdicts.evidence: The write at f1:63 records host and user values as data without testing them or deciding whether any payload runs. The shell connection is invoked separately at f1:59.

The platform comparison selects the shell executable used for the same network-connected shell behaviour on either branch. This changes how the payload starts and is plumbing rather than a gate under the stated definition.

The try block unconditionally attempts the evidence-file write and merely swallows any exception; it contains no environmental decision. Hostname and username are serialized as data, while the shell connection is invoked before this block.

Both arms of the ternary spawn a shell, and the resulting process receives the same network piping at f1:39-41. Selecting the executable by platform only changes how the payload starts, which the gate definition excludes as plumbing.
